summary: All three canonical source roots exist and are inside the same parent Git worktree at E:/Project2026. They are not independently owned repositories. The parent source repository has no configured remotes, no origin, no upstream tracking branch, and a large pre-existing dirty working tree. Local commits are technically possible, but remote push is blocked until a private remote is configured and verified. Future Phase 1 work should expect one source commit SHA if the existing repository boundary is retained, but only after user/unknown-owned changes are isolated or explicitly approved.
